payload.description: fgos return leaves its verify checkout behind under /tmp/fgos-worktrees (worktree remove refused: worktree-ignored-bytes-preserved). Seen on design-lap release 5f311fca returning tsk-vafbcqyzyt, a docs-only item whose verify was only git diff --check and grep: the retained checkout held 3.3 GB, of which target/ was 2.7 GB, plus generated .claude/skills (110) and .agents/skills (102) and .pi .omp .grok .fgos/runtime. Every return on this machine will leak one such checkout until /tmp fills. The verify checkout is fgOS-owned scratch, so its cleanup should remove the bytes fgOS itself put there rather than refuse
